\subsection*{Part I --- Foundations (Beginner $\to$ CF 2000)}
\begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}c c >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{3.6cm} X@{}}
\toprule

\midrule
\yes & 1 & Introduction to Graphs & Degrees and counting (Find the Town Judge, Maximal Network Rank) $\cdot$ Reachability (Find if Path Exists in Graph, Keys and Rooms) $\cdot$ Grids as graphs (Counting Rooms, Max Area of Island) $\cdot$ Implicit state graphs (Two Buttons, Open the Lock) $\cdot$ Functional graphs: one outgoing edge (Badge, Longest Cycle in a Graph, Find the Duplicate Number) \\
\yes & 2 & Depth-First Search & Cycle detection and recovery (Round Trip, Round Trip II) $\cdot$ Subtree aggregation and push-down (White-Black Balanced Subtrees, Count Nodes With the Highest Score, Ki) $\cdot$ Entry and exit times (Military Problem, Count Descendants, Maze) $\cdot$ Backtracking over paths (All Paths From Source to Target, Path with Maximum Gold) $\cdot$ Reverse search: start from the target (All Ancestors of a Node in a Directed Acyclic Graph, Solve The Maze) \\
$\circ$ & 3 & Breadth-First Search & Shortest paths and reconstruction (Message Route, Labyrinth) $\cdot$ Multi-source BFS (Rotting Oranges, Monsters) $\cdot$ Multi-dimensional states (Shortest Path in a Grid with Obstacles Elimination, Shortest Path to Get All Keys) $\cdot$ Distances from two ends and second-shortest paths (Fight Against Traffic, Second Minimum Time to Reach Destination) $\cdot$ The shortest-path DAG (Number of Shortest paths, Navigation System) \\
$\circ$ & 4 & Components \& Bipartite Graphs & Counting and connecting components (Building Roads, Ice Skating) $\cdot$ Properties of a component (Cyclic Components, Count the Number of Complete Components) $\cdot$ Bipartite check (Building Teams, Mahmoud and Ehab and the bipartiteness) $\cdot$ Counting colourings and parity (Beautiful Graph, Even Relation) $\cdot$ Components as units (Smallest String With Swaps, Learning Languages) \\
$\circ$ & 5 & DAGs \& Topological Sorting & Ordering with dependencies (Course Schedule, Build a Matrix With Conditions) $\cdot$ Priority and grouped orders (Course Schedule II, Sort Items by Groups Respecting Dependencies) $\cdot$ Paths in a DAG (Longest Flight Route, Game Routes) $\cdot$ Cycles versus order (Find Eventual Safe States, Directing Edges) $\cdot$ Implicit DAGs (Fox And Names, Substring) \\
$\circ$ & 6 & Disjoint Set Union & Incremental connectivity (Road Construction, Count Unreachable Pairs of Nodes in an Undirected Graph) $\cdot$ Equivalence classes (Accounts Merge, Satisfiability of Equality Equations) $\cdot$ Weighted (potential) DSU (Evaluate Division, People on a Line) $\cdot$ Offline queries (Checking Existence of Edge Length Limited Paths, Destroying Array) $\cdot$ DSU as a building block (Secret Passwords, Vessels) \\
\bottomrule
